identity.note: Third-generation Tiguan, on sale from 2024 — the generation a 2026 plate carries. NOT the Mk2 AD1 (2016-2023) and NOT the China-market Tiguan L, which is 4.735 m and is the only recent Tiguan currently in the catalogue. Source photographs for the generated mesh: a 1.5 eTSI ACT R-Line in Persimmon Red, photographed 2026-02-14 at a MOLL dealership, Wikimedia Commons, front-left and rear-left three-quarter — ONE car, two views. Trim-specific values are recorded as the R-Line fitment. Overhangs, tracks and cabin landmarks deliberately omitted: unverified, and this project does not fabricate vehicle metadata.

provenance.limitation: Both photographs show the LEFT flank. There is no right-side, no true side and no straight front or rear view, so the right flank is unobserved and the recorded perspective bake applies to any mesh built from them.
